scope: F22 bounded workspace team discovery and explicit-team project discovery from the command palette.
behavior: 150 ms debounce and fair combined maximum of 20 remote issue/team/project rows; matching static commands remain separate.
Team query is trimmed, literal case-insensitive name/key search, at most 100 Unicode scalars without control characters; existing private visibility/state rules remain authoritative.
Team-only signed cursor binds normalized query/state/limit, workspace, principal and authorization epoch; generic directory queries stay unchanged.
Projects are queried only for the explicit route team, without team fanout or implicit default selection.
Previous remote rows clear synchronously on query/workspace/authority/team changes; obsolete requests abort and late responses are ignored.
Each group shows its own API validation or failure and retry; 101-scalar issue queries remain independent of 100-scalar team/project limits.
Team/project invocation requires a fresh authorized detail GET, matching identity/scope and active state, before normal guarded navigation.

Cached bootstrap team commands are replaced in the palette by bounded authorized team results, avoiding duplicate IDs and an invocation bypass. Empty queries retain other commands and reference-only issue recents.
